source='''def transform(grid):
    """Recolor every complete, uniform row or column to color 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(value == row[0] for value in row):
            marked.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        value = grid[0][c]
        if all(grid[r][c] == value for r in range(h)):
            marked.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in marked:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
